description_full: FIH Mobile Limited, an investment holding company, designs, manufactures, trades in, and repairs handsets worldwide. The company offers mobile/IoT devices; smart manufacturing services; intelligent automotive; software engineering; and vertical solutions. It also engages in research and development activities; manufacture and sale of electronic products; and import and export activities. The company was formerly known as Foxconn International Holdings Limited and changed its name to FIH Mobile Limited in May 2013. FIH Mobile Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. FIH Mobile Limited operates as a subsidiary of Foxconn (Far East) Limited.

R&D investment of 1% of revenue (limited) signals commitment to product development and talent.
financial_summary: FIH Mobile Ltd is a small-cap technology business with a $1.2B market cap on $6.7B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -11% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.

Returns on capital run at -10% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, and 2% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.
The company is burning through $79M of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 3.1% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 65% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
